rationale: Read prompt, contract, starter, skeleton, hints, approach, five criteria, 10 visible and 17 hidden tests and the reference. Fixture figures (27 vs 30, returns 10 to 7, cautious 22/24, costs 0, 0.35, 0.4, p95 12/2400/1840, candidate failures 3/1/2/0, messy counts) recomputed by hand and match. Reference passes in the real sandbox; five registered known-wrong variants fail; my probe adds starter, off-by-one p95 and tool-before-retrieval variants, each failing. Defects found and fixed: (1) the skeleton declared answers, slices and bySlice as plain {} objects while the prompt requires preserving __proto__ ids/slices and a critical-criterion hidden test checks it, so a skeleton-shaped solution failed core; skeleton now uses Object.create(null) and hint 1 says why. (2) The reference trimmed slice names before the empty check while rule 7 says a slice joins unlabelled only when it is not a non-empty string; the reference now matches the prompt (no test depended on it). Wording 4: the prompt is long, though precise.
